c01-big-brown-dog-small-white-dog.observed_description: A large chocolate-brown Labrador sits on the left and a small fluffy white dog on the right on a green park lawn, both facing the camera; the brown dog is about twice as tall, so bigger/smaller reads at a glance at 180 px. No people, text or other animals.
c01-big-brown-dog-small-white-dog.note: Accepted first time: The brown dog is bigger than the white dog. / The white dog is smaller than the brown dog.

c02-bus-and-small-car.observed_description: Side view of a long white city bus with a blue stripe and a small red hatchback on a quiet street; the car stands in front of the bus's rear half, overlapping it, instead of leaving a gap, but it is clearly a third of the bus's length. The bus display is blank; no digits, letters or people.
c02-bus-and-small-car.note: Accepted: the size comparison is unmistakable even with the overlap. The bus is bigger than the car.

c03-grandfather-and-boy-bench.observed_description: A white-haired grandfather in a beige cardigan and a boy of about eight in a blue-and-white striped T-shirt sit side by side on a wooden park bench, smiling at each other, faces in three-quarter view; old and young read instantly. Only these two people.
c03-grandfather-and-boy-bench.note: Accepted: The grandfather is older than the boy. / The boy is younger than the grandfather.
